modules.title: Design Principles
modules.description: Learn about the fundamental principles of design, including balance, contrast, emphasis, movement, pattern, unity, and white space.

sub_modules.title: Balance and Contrast
sub_modules.description: Understand the concepts of balance and contrast in design, including symmetrical and asymmetrical composition.

learning_objectives.description: Understand the definition of balance and contrast in design.
Apply the concept of balance to a design composition.
Understand how contrast is used in design to create visual interest.

sub_modules.title: Emphasis and Movement
sub_modules.description: Learn about the role of emphasis and movement in creating visually appealing designs.

learning_objectives.description: Understand how emphasis is used to draw attention in design.
Apply the concept of movement to create a sense of energy in a design.
Understand how to use visual hierarchy to create emphasis in design.

sub_modules.title: Pattern and Unity
sub_modules.description: Learn about the role of pattern and unity in creating visually appealing designs.

learning_objectives.description: Understand how pattern is used to create visual interest in design.
Apply the concept of unity to create a cohesive design.
Understand how to use repetition and symmetry to create unity in design.

sub_modules.title: White Space
sub_modules.description: Learn about the role of white space in creating a visually appealing design.

learning_objectives.description: Understand the importance of white space in creating a clean design.
Apply the concept of white space to create a more balanced design.
Understand how to use white space effectively in design.
